rows.method: Official-engine breadth-first search to depth 17. Actions are 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7 and three click tripwires. Each depth also applies all 4096 display clicks on the first node. RESET's successor at this start is that same click successor.

Official-engine breadth-first search to depth 13 with RESET in the alphabet. Same state key as level 1. A level reset returns to the start key. A full reset at action count 0 sets score to 0 and leaves the step budget at 30.
